import numpy as np
def fitc(cols):
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt),c
